create.name: Bruce Taylor
create.bio:
Bruce Taylor teaches meditation, Zen practice and traditional Japanese Usui Reiki Ryōhō through Roots of Life, the school and YouTube channel he runs from France. He taught in secondary schools in Chicago and Hong Kong before turning to this work full time, and he spends part of each year in Kyoto, practising on Mount Hiei and Mount Kurama, the mountain linked with the origins of the Usui lineage. His approach to Reiki is plain and historical: he presents it as a daily practice of stillness rooted in its Japanese sources rather than as a set of techniques.

His online Reiki training covers all three traditional levels, Shōden, Okuden and Shinpiden, in more than a hundred recorded lessons, and he leads a free live Reiki circle on Zoom every Thursday. He also guides small-group pilgrimages to Kyoto that meet temple priests and Reiki teachers there, and offers mentoring. His book Touching Silence draws together Zen, Reiki and reflections on physics. The channel, active since 2011, posts a new video each Saturday on how Reiki is learned and practised, attunements and self-practice.

courses.title: Usui Reiki Ryōhō: The Complete Self-Paced Package
courses.description: Recorded lessons covering the first, second and teacher levels of the Japanese Usui system, worked through at your own pace with his support. Completing it leads to teacher and practitioner certification in his lineage; Shōden can also be bought on its own for $345.

courses.title: The Deep Roots Pilgrimage to Kyoto (May 2027)
courses.description: A nine-day small-group pilgrimage in Kyoto with planned meetings with temple priests on Mount Hiei and Mount Kurama, Reiki teachers from his own line and a Zen teacher. Limited to twenty places.

free_resources.title: Weekly Global Reiki Circle
free_resources.description: A free live Reiki practice on Zoom each Thursday at 17:00 Paris time, open to people with or without Reiki training. Registration is a short free sign-up.
